name: NVDA vs AMD: Price Action, Relative Performance & Correlation
description: Research study comparing NVDA and AMD across price action, relative performance, and correlation. Includes normalized price performance indexed to 100, rolling 60-day return spread (NVDA minus AMD) with dual-color area fill, rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns, and a cross-sectional summary table with total return, annualized volatility, max drawdown, Sharpe ratio, and pairwise correlation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD: PRICE ACTION, RELATIVE PERFORMANCE & CORRELATION
# =============================================================================
# Compares NVDA and AMD across:
#   1. Normalized price performance (indexed to 100)
#   2. Rolling 60-day return spread (NVDA minus AMD)
#   3. Rolling 60-day correlation of daily returns
#   4. Summary stats: total return, ann. vol, max drawdown, Sharpe, correlation
#
# Both assets are primary (for cs_lines and cs_summary_table).
# Reference data sources load explicit prices for pair-level calculations.
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary data source (per-asset: NVDA or AMD depending on asset) ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Normalized price indexed to 100 ---
first_close = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.First)(close)
norm_price = close / first_close * 100.0

bar_ts = index()

# --- Reference data for pair-level calculations ---
nvda_ref_o, nvda_ref_h, nvda_ref_l, nvda_ref_c, nvda_ref_v, nvda_ref_vw, nvda_ref_n = reference_stocks(ticker='NVDA')()
amd_ref_o, amd_ref_h, amd_ref_l, amd_ref_c, amd_ref_v, amd_ref_vw, amd_ref_n = reference_stocks(ticker='AMD')()
nvda_close = ffill(nvda_ref_c)
amd_close = ffill(amd_ref_c)

# Daily returns for each
ret_nvda = returns(period=1)(nvda_close)
ret_amd = returns(period=1)(amd_close)

# --- Rolling 60-day return spread (NVDA minus AMD cumulative 60d returns) ---
nvda_60d = (nvda_close - (nvda_close >> 60)) / (nvda_close >> 60)
amd_60d = (amd_close - (amd_close >> 60)) / (amd_close >> 60)
spread_60d = nvda_60d - amd_60d

# Split into positive/negative for dual-color area fill
spread_pos = spread_60d if spread_60d > 0 else 0.0 / 0.0
spread_neg = spread_60d if spread_60d < 0 else 0.0 / 0.0

# --- Rolling 60-day correlation ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_nvda, y=ret_amd)

# --- Per-asset summary metrics ---
# Total return (cumulative product of 1+daily return, minus 1)
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1.0 + daily_ret)
total_return = cum_ret - 1.0

# Annualized volatility (252-day rolling, take last value via agg=Last)
ann_vol = volatility(period=252)(close)

# Max drawdown
running_max = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(close)
drawdown = (close - running_max) / running_max
max_dd = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(drawdown)

# Sharpe ratio (annualized): mean(daily_ret) / std(daily_ret) * sqrt(252)
cum_mean_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(daily_ret)
cum_std_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Std)(daily_ret)
sharpe = cum_mean_ret / cum_std_ret * sqrt(252.0)

# Expanding correlation between NVDA and AMD daily returns
expand_corr = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_nvda, y=ret_amd)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# Chart 1: Normalized price performance (cs_lines — one line per asset)
cs_lines(
    title='Indexed Price Performance (Base = 100)',
    category='1. Price Action',
    y_axis_label='Indexed Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=norm_price)

# Chart 2: Rolling 60-day return spread with dual-color area fill
xy_lines(
    title='NVDA vs AMD: Rolling 60-Day Return Spread',
    category='2. Relative Performance',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='60-Day Return Spread (NVDA minus AMD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA Outperforming', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='AMD Outperforming', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, spread_pos, spread_neg)

# Chart 3: Rolling 60-day correlation
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation',
    category='3. Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation (Returns-Based, 60d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='0')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day Rolling Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# Table: Key stats per asset
cs_summary_table(
    title='Key Statistics',
    category='4. Summary',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Key Statistics',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ann. Volatility', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Max Drawdown', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Sharpe Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=4
)(total_return, ann_vol, max_dd, sharpe, expand_corr)
